title: 새 옷 사기 전,
이 3개 먼저

segments.label: 머플러 3가지
en: Wearing your scarf only around your neck? You're missing out
01 Commute: fold it in half and pull the ends through the loop
02 Date: drape it over your shoulders like a shawl and belt it
03 Weekend: wear it like a hood, then wrap it around your neck
Formula: long and wide, one pop of color, small knot
Save it before you head out — Source: KMA forecast

segments.label: 남자 두 색 6벌
en: Men's outfits in 10 seconds: just pick two colors
Slate blue & stone: suede blouson, blue knit, chore jacket (easiest)
Terracotta & sage: corduroy blazer, cable knit, coach jacket
Formula: one color for the big pieces, the other for inner layers and caps
Save it and check it in front of your closet

segments.label: 2개로 4가지
en: Two items, styled four different ways
Black shearling + grey check skirt: long boots, hoodie, headphones
Ecru cardigan + barrel jeans: belted, striped tee, chunky loafers
Formula: keep the two items, swap shoes, inner layers and accessories
Save it before your weekend outing — Source: KMA forecast
